content_zh:
“放开余师兄……”
过了半晌，那两个道童才反应了过来，齐声大喝，要冲过来抢人。
“谁敢！”
方行忽然直起身来，体内灵气一震，一道莫名威压释放了出来。
两个道童只觉胆子一寒，呆在了原地，畏畏缩缩不敢上前。
“王志，吊死鬼，小雀斑，你们把这两个家伙捆起来，耗子精，罗圈腿，你们两个跑去药司监告状，就说我们逮到了三个大白天来灵药田盗药的家伙……”
方行冷冷吩咐，同时从旁边灵药田里扯了一把灵药，也不管是啥，直接塞进了胖道士怀里。
“这样……不好吧……”
王志等人吓的战战兢兢，心下迟疑，不敢动弹。
“怕什么？这几个家伙一不是药司监的人，二不是奉了药司监的命，就敢耀武扬威跑到药司监来撒野，我就不信药司监的人心里没疙瘩……对了，那个谁，耗子精，你不是有一根金钗么？就是跟你家里的未婚妻定亲的那个，拿过来，塞他怀里，就说他带着两个人，跑来让我们偷偷给他几株灵药，我们不敢给，他们就抢，还明目障胆索要贿赂……”
“我……好……我的钗子还能拿回来吧？”
众道童被方行一说，明白了过来，拿绳子的拿绳子，取金钗的取金钗。
跑的最快的罗圈腿，已经准备去药司监告状了。
“慢……慢着……”
众人回头，开口的竟然是被揍的鼻青脸肿的胖道士。
方行那番话，他可是也听见了，起初不以为然，却是越想越心惊。
是啊，自己毕竟不是药司监的，来这里本来就是名不正，言不顺，这个小浑蛋诬自己抢灵药别人不可能相信，毕竟青云山道门规矩森严，还真没有敢明抢灵药的，这乃是道门公有的资源，也是严令，然而万一药司监那些人真以为自己是过来索贿的，自己可大是不妙。
上级的人享受下级的孝敬乃是天经地义，但是不能越界啊……
再加上，就算真把所有的事都说清了，但自己被一个十岁的道童打的满脸是血，还让人像肥猪一样的捆了起来送给药司监处置，这一世英名也就毁了。
就连自家杂司监的统领师兄也会感觉大失颜面，估计会恨上自己。

绝对不能把事闹大！
胖道人其实逮着方行在当职时间去打猎这个由头来拿捏方行的根子，便在于他认为方行不敢把事情闹大，可谁知道这小子压根不知道什么叫怕，不仅直接把自己给揍了，还明目障胆的诬陷自己，道门重若命根子一样的灵药啊，说拔就拔下来了……
这小子太猛，不好拿捏，没办法，低头吧！
胖道人一瞬间想通了这茬，便急忙叫道：“误会，都是误会，大家闹着玩，就别惊动药司监的师兄们了，小子，你把我放起来，咱们有话好好说……”
听了胖道人的话，众道童都面面相觑，显然大出意外。
只有方行冷冷一笑，早就猜到了这个结果。
他刚才那些话，与其是对王志等人说的，还不如说是说给胖道士听的。
“哎呀呀，猪师兄，都怪小弟，不知道你闹着玩，下手重了……”
方行宛若忽然间换了一张脸，笑嘻嘻的将胖道人扶了起，还殷勤的给他拍打身上的土。
“老子姓余，不姓朱……”
胖道人坐了起来，心里一动，自己虽然挨了不少拳脚，但可没受内伤，还能动手……
他刚才主要是被方行偷袭了，才还不出手来，若真要动手，不见得怕他。
不过，也就在他这个想法升起来的时候，忽然间眼花一花，一柄明晃晃的刀子抵在了自己脖子上，森凉的触感顿时让胖道士清醒了几分，方行看起来圆圆可爱的小脸凑近了胖道士，低声道：“死肥猪，别给脸不要脸，小爷天不怕地不怕，闹大了咱们看谁吃亏！”
“这小王八蛋是个疯子啊……”
胖道士心里吃了一惊，再动手的心思立刻就没了。
“算你狠，这次道爷认栽了，天长地久，咱们走着瞧……”
“嘿嘿，真要走着瞧，不定谁让谁好看呢，也是看到了你，小爷才知道自己也能成为外门弟子了……”

content_en:
"Let go of Senior Brother Yu..."
After a long while, the two Taoist boys reacted and shouted in unison, trying to rush over and snatch people away.
"Who dares!"
Fang Xing suddenly straightened up, the spiritual energy in his body shook, and an inexplicable pressure was released.
The two Taoist boys felt a chill in their courage and stayed where they were, timid and afraid to step forward.
"Wang Zhi, Hanged Ghost, Little Freckles, you tie up these two guys, Rat Jing, Bow-legged, you two go to the Pharmacy Supervisor to file a complaint, saying that we caught three guys who came to the elixir field in broad daylight to steal medicine..."
Fang Xing ordered coldly, and at the same time pulled a handful of elixir from the elixir field nearby, and stuffed it directly into the arms of the fat Taoist priest, regardless of what it was.
"Isn't this... not good..."
Wang Zhi and others were so frightened that they hesitated and did not dare to move.
"What are you afraid of? These guys are not from the Medical Supervisor, and secondly, they are not under the orders of the Medical Supervisor. They dare to show off their power and go to the Medical Supervisor to run wild. I don't believe that the Medical Supervisor has no conscience... By the way, who is that, rat spirit, don't you have it? A gold hairpin? It's the one who was engaged to your fiancée. Take it and stuff it into his arms. Then he came with two people and asked us to secretly give him some elixir. We didn't dare to give it to him, so they robbed it and even asked for bribes..."
"I...okay...can I still get my hairpin back?"
After being told by Fang Xingyi, all the Taoist boys understood. Those who took the rope took the rope, and those who took the gold hairpin took the gold hairpin.
The fastest runner with bow legs is already preparing to file a complaint with the Pharmacy Supervisor.
"Slow...slow..."
Everyone turned around, and the one who spoke was the fat Taoist priest who had been beaten and bruised.
He also heard what Fang Xing said. He didn't take it seriously at first, but the more he thought about it, the more frightened he became.
Yes, after all, I am not the Medicine Supervisor. I came here because of my reputation and my words. It is impossible for others to believe this little bastard who falsely accuses me of robbing the elixir. After all, the Taoist sect in Qingyun Mountain has strict rules and no one dares to openly steal the elixir. This is a Taoist public resource and a strict order. However, if the Medicine Superintendent really thinks that he is here to ask for a bribe, he will be in serious trouble.
It is natural for superiors to enjoy the filial piety of subordinates, but they cannot cross the line...
In addition, even if everything was explained clearly, his face would be covered in blood after being beaten by a ten-year-old Taoist boy, and he would be tied up like a fat pig and sent to the Medicine Superintendent for disposal. His reputation in this life would be ruined.
Even the senior brother who is the leader of his own miscellaneous supervisor will feel humiliated and will probably hate him.
You must not make a big deal out of it!
The reason why the fat Taoist caught Fang Xing hunting while he was on duty was because he believed that Fang Xing did not dare to make a big deal out of the matter. But who knew that this kid didn't know what fear was. Not only did he beat himself up directly, he also blatantly and boldly framed himself. Taoism is as important as the lifeblood of a panacea, and he pulled it out as soon as he said...
This kid is too fierce and difficult to control. There is nothing you can do about it, just lower your head!
The fat Taoist figured out the problem in an instant, and hurriedly shouted: "Misunderstandings, it's all misunderstandings, everyone is just joking, so don't disturb the senior fellows of the Pharmacy Supervisor. Boy, put me down, let's talk carefully..."
After hearing what the fat Taoist said, all the Taoist boys looked at each other, obviously very surprised.
Only Fang Xing smiled coldly, having already guessed this result.
Those words he just said were meant for the fat Taoist priest rather than to Wang Zhi and others.
"Oops, Brother Zhu, it's all my fault. I didn't know you were joking, so you hit hard..."
Fang Xingwan's face suddenly changed. He helped the fat Taoist up with a smile and patted the dirt on his body diligently.
"My surname is Yu, not Zhu..."
The fat Taoist sat up and felt something in his heart. Although he had received a lot of punches and kicks, he had not suffered any internal injuries and could still take action...
He was mainly attacked by Fang Xing just now.Take action, if you really want to take action, you may not be afraid of him.
However, just when this thought came to his mind, he was suddenly dazzled, and a bright knife was pressed against his neck. The cool touch suddenly made the fat Taoist sober. Fang Xing's round and cute little face came close to the fat Taoist and whispered: "Damn fat pig, don't be shameless. I am not afraid of anything. If it makes a big fuss, let's see who will suffer!"
"This little bastard is a lunatic..."
The fat Taoist priest was shocked, and immediately lost all intention of doing anything again.
"You're cruel, Taoist Master has admitted defeat this time. It will last forever. Let's wait and see..."
"Hehe, we have to wait and see, I don't know who will look good to whom. It was only after I saw you that I realized that I can also become an outer disciple..."
